hirecar by telephone from a nearby coal shop. (Time
9.04a.m.).
Johnson hirecar S.M.C. No. 18562 driven by
Dsien Ah Liang (錢阿良) (2nd. accused) then
arrived. Peu Ziang Sung entered and sat beside
the 2nd. accused while the other two sat in the
rear.
On the instructions of his passengers, the
2nd. accused drove to Brenan Road near the Kan
Koong Primary School. Here he was given $20.00
by Wong Yih Pei and told to take off his uniform
jacket and get out of the car. (It is to be noted

My name is Pou Ziang Sung, age 32 years, native of S'hai,
M/chauffeur, Driving Permit No.10673, residing at Fo.5 Co Mah
Fong, Connaught road.

Formerly I was a chauffeur in the employ of one named Loo
Ts Ping, an interpreter of the Japanese Gendarmerie, 94
Jessfield road, who owned M/car Lic. No.10500. At the end of
September last year, when Loo Ts Ping was attending a dinner
party at the Van Lee Restaurant, Foochow Road, he was
assassinated. Later, through the introduction of one named
Voong Kuan Foh, master of the Yoong Fah M/Car Repairing Shop,
Brenan road and concurrently an interpreter to the Kang Dah
Cotton Mill, 138 Jessfield road, I became a chauffeur to Vice-
Captain "Ts Dien" (Shida), driving M/car Lic.No.8688.

At about 1 p.m. 14-8-40 I went to the Yoong Fah M/Car
Repairing Shop, Brenan Road, to see Voong Kuan Foh, who told
me that "Ts Dien" had been promoted to the rank of Captain of
the Japanese Gendarmerie and will soon be transferred to Nantao
to organize ambulances. He terminated my services and would
give me $75.00 as a gratitude. I asked Voong Kuan Foh to
ask "Ts Dien" to give me $100.00 instead of $75.00, which he
promised to do and would let me know after he had interviewed
"Ts Dien", but up to date I still didn't hear anything from
him.

At about 4 p.m. 12-8-40 whilst passing a food shop on Co
Ping road off Brenan road, I noticed therein my acquaintances
Lieu I Loong and Wang Yih Pei. On seeing me, they asked me to
join them which I did. Both of them are members of a Special

我叫潘将生，32岁，上海籍，
职业司机，驾驶执照号 10673，居住在康纳脱路
和合坊（Co Mah Fong）5号。

此前我受雇于一名叫陆子平（Loo Ts Ping）的人做司机，
他是日本宪兵队的翻译，住在极司菲尔路94号，
拥有汽车牌照号 10500。去年9月底，陆子平在
福州路万利餐馆（Van Lee Restaurant）参加晚宴时
被刺杀。后来，通过永发汽车修理行（Yoong Fah M/Car Repairing Shop）
老板兼康达棉纺厂（Kang Dah Cotton Mill，极司菲尔路138号）
翻译冯冠福（Voong Kuan Foh）的介绍，我成为
日本宪兵队副队长“石田”（Ts Dien/Shida）的司机，
驾驶汽车牌照号 8688。

1940年8月14日下午1点左右，我去布伦南路的
永发汽车修理行看望冯冠福，他告诉我“石田”
已晋升为日本宪兵队队长，并将很快调往南市
组织救护车队伍。他解雇了我，并给我75.00美元
作为酬谢。我请冯冠福请求“石田”给我100.00美元
而不是75.00美元，他答应去做，并说在面谈“石田”
后会通知我，但至今我仍未收到他的消息。

1940年8月12日下午4点左右，当我路过布伦南路旁
协和路（Co Ping road）上的一家食品店时，注意到
我的熟人刘士龙（Lieu I Loong）和王一飞（Wang Yih Pei）
在里面。看到我便邀请我加入，我照办了。
两人均隶属于新乐村（Sing Leh Tsung）22号的特种

pages.en:
-Sheet 2-

Service Corp attached to 22 Sing Leh Tsung. About 15 minutes
later Wong Yih Fei told me that they intended to kidnap a
certain person and asked me whether I would like to join them
and would let me have a share of the ransom. I agreed. We
then arranged to meet again at 7 p.m. on 18-8-40 at the same
place to make further discussion.

I failed to keep this appointment and at about 8 a.m.
19-8-40 one named "Siau Ling" (Liang Ching Piau) came to my
home and told me that Lieu I Leong and Wong Yih Fei were waiting
for me at the Oo Ping Lodging House. I immediately attended
and after a further discussion for about half-an-hour, "Siau
Ling" went out and promised to wait for us opposite the Han
Keong Primary School on Bremen Road. I together with Lieu I
Leong and Wong Yih Fei then took public rickshas to the San Kyi
Feng off Beenfield Road near Tifeng road where we alighted.
Wong Yih Fei entered a nearby coal shop where he telephoned for
a Johnson hire car.

When the Johnson hire car arrived, I entered the front
portion and sat beside the chauffeur whilst Lieu I Leong and
Wong Yih Fei sat at the rear. I instructed the chauffeur to
drive us to Zan Ka Dee. On arriving at Bremen Road near
Edinburgh Road, a spot not far from the Han Keong Primary School
I instructed the chauffeur to stop the car. Wong Yih Fei then
instructed the chauffeur to make a turn. Upon this being done,
Wong Yih Fei handed to the chauffeur two $10.00 banknotes,
ordered him to take down his uniform jacket and alight from the
car. Lieu I Leong and Wong Yih Fei then took the chauffeur away.
pages.zh:
-第2页-

服务队成员。约15分钟后，王一飞（Wong Yih Fei）
告诉我他们打算绑架某人，并问我是否愿意加入，
并分给我一份赎金。我同意了。我们随后约定
于1940年8月18日晚上7点在同一地点再次会面
以作进一步讨论。

我未能赴约，1940年8月19日上午8点左右，
一个叫“小林”（梁金标/Liang Ching Piau）的人来到
我家，告诉我刘士龙（Lieu I Leong）和王一飞（Wong Yih Fei）
正在和平旅馆等我。我立即前往，经过约半小时

到达爱丁堡路附近的布伦南路（Bremen Road），
即离汉公小学不远的一处地方时，我指示司机停车。

王一飞递给司机两张10.00美元钞票，

"Siau Ling" who was waiting nearby then entered the car.
He carried with him one Mauser pistol and a small pistol. A
few minutes later Lieu Z Leong came back, handed me the
uniform jacket and asked me to put it on. He also entered
the car and asked me to drive to Gordon Road near Haiphong

yard Wee, 822 Gordon Road, where I stopped. Lieu Z Leong
and "Siau Ling" then alighted, carrying with them the pistols
and waited outside a bamboo fence at the corner of Gordon
and Haiphong Roads. After waiting for about half-an-hour
they came back and told me that the intended victim had
already passed that locality in a private ricksha and that we
have to wait for another chance. "Siau Ling" then asked me
to drive the car along Penang Road and Singapore Road and
when reached Sing Leh Teong, they alighted. "Siau Ling"
asked me to drive the car to Jessfield Road near Tifeng Road.
I did as told and on reaching this spot, I was arrested by
a Police party.

This is my true statement.

“小林”随后让我驾车沿槟榔路（Penang Road）和新加坡路

“小林”让我驾车前往地丰路附近的极司菲尔路。

我此前受雇于黄浦浚浦局担任司机，并在强生出租汽车公司担任司机已十八个月。

1940年8月19日上午9时05分，我在愚园路与胶州路路角的强生出租服务第一站点等候时，奉命驾驶电机车牌照第13562号前往极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）提丰池（Tifeng Pond）附近的三义坊弄堂接载乘客。抵达该地后，三名中国男子登上汽车，两人坐在后排，一人坐在我旁边（此人我现在确认为 Peu Ziang Sung（音译））。坐在我旁边的人指令我驶往曹家渡（Zan Ka Dec.，原文拼写有误，应为曹家渡）。当行驶至爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）附近的布伦南路（Bremen Road，原文如此，通常译为布伦南路或贝伦路）时，我被指令在坎公小学对面的一条弄堂外停车。随后，坐在后排的两名乘客中的一人指令我将车掉头，我告诉他此处过于拥挤不便掉头，但他坚持要求，我便照办了。事后，他又指令我脱下制服上衣，我也照做了。接着他递给我两张10元钞票，指令我下车。随后，坐在后排的两人护送我进入弄堂，另一名身穿灰色短衣的人让前述那人再给我5元，他说这是给我的，不是给公司的。大约5分钟后，后者离开，但

former still remained with me for about half-an-hour. During
this interval he asked me not to report this matter to the
Police but I told him that I must report because if it would
be discovered by my company I will be dismissed. He then
told me if I insist to report, don't tell the Police the
actual route taken, only tell the Police that the car was
driven to Columbia Road near Fah Win Village, otherwise he
will shot me. Then he escorted me out the alleyway, walked
along Brenan road, to Edinburgh road and then Yu Yuan Road
where he told me that I would find my car on Jessfield Road
near Tifeng Road and he walked away. I then entered a nearby
carpenter shop where I telephoned to my company and was
instructed to report this matter to the Police.
Being afraid that they would shot me if I tell the truth
I told the Police as what I was told.
At 10 a.m. 21-8-40, I was called to attend the Bubbling
Well Police Station, where after further interrogation, I tell
the above to the Police as my true statement.

前者仍与我在一起约半小时。在此期间，他要求我不要向警方报告此事，但我告诉他我必须报告，因为如果被公司发现，我将被解雇。于是他告诉我，如果我坚持要报告，不要告诉警方实际行驶的路线，只告诉警方车子被开到了法华村（Fah Win Village，音译）附近的哥伦比亚路（Columbia Road），否则他就枪杀我。随后他护送我走出弄堂，沿布伦南路（Brenan road）行走，至爱丁堡路，再到愚园路，在那里他告诉我，我会在极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）靠近提丰路（Tifeng Road）的地方找到我的车，然后他便离开了。我随即进入附近的一家木匠店，打电话给公司，并奉命向警方报告此事。
由于害怕如果说出实情他们会枪杀我，我便按照他们告诉我的内容向警方作了陈述。
1940年8月21日上午10时，我被传唤至静安寺巡捕房，在经过进一步讯问后，我向警方如实陈述了上述情况。

the intended victim was employed. Enquiries (with the
accused temporarily detained at Gordon Road Station)
revealed that Mr. T.C. Tsung (鍾才卿), manager of
the Tulco Co., was the only person who used a private
ricksha. He remarked that at about 10a.m. whilst on
Gordon Road near the factory his ricksha was nearly run
down by a Johnson hire car.
Mr. T.C. Tsung was warned to take care when
proceeding to and from his office in the future. The
Sen. Det. 1/8 Gordon Road was also informed of what had
occurred.
On the instructions of Supt. Chisnall, D.D.C. "E",
the accused will be put before the S.S.D. Court on
20/8/40 and a writ authorising his detention for one
week will be requested to enable further enquiries to
